title: ABBirdLaunchTests.BirdLaunchRecordsTheExactVelocityAfterItIsAssigned fails, and has never been captured passing
discovery: This wave ran ALL eight EditMode test classes as partitions for the first time: 44 tests, 43 passed, 1 failed.

neverPreviouslyMeasured.claim: No retained EditMode XML anywhere in .omo/evidence contains ABBirdLaunchTests
neverPreviouslyMeasured.method: grep -rl ABBirdLaunch --include=*.xml over the whole evidence tree returned only this waves own receipt
neverPreviouslyMeasured.implication: Every prior EditMode receipt in this plan (11/11, 33/33, 37/37 partitions) excluded this class, so its failure was never visible.

rootCause.explanation: _rigidBody is assigned in ABGameObject.Awake() via GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>(). Unity does not invoke Awake() for a component added with AddComponent in EditMode unless the type is marked ExecuteAlways or ExecuteInEditMode. ABBirdLaunchTests adds a Rigidbody2D and an ABBird and then immediately invokes the private seam, so _rigidBody is still null.
rootCause.verdict: test defect, not a production defect

productionPathProvenLive.source: published-smoke-output/shot_001/physics_events.jsonl from the Phase 2 happy run against the published archive
productionPathProvenLive.interpretation: The real published player executed AssignLaunchVelocityAndRecord and recorded a genuine launch velocity through PhysicalSnapshotRuntime.RecordLaunchCallback. The behaviour the failing test intends to assert demonstrably works in the real runtime.

impactOnFinalWave.reason: Todo 2 acceptance requires EditMode tests asserting the launch velocity behaviour. A test that has never passed does not satisfy that criterion, even though the production path is independently proven live. F2 cannot approve while the plans own suite has a failing test.

proposedFix: Initialise the component graph the way Unity would before invoking the seam, for example by invoking the protected Awake through reflection after AddComponent, so _rigidBody resolves. This is a test-only change.
costOfFix: A test-only commit still re-pins the wave, because provenance.json embeds project.git_head and project.git_tree, so the archive identity changes and the build, publish, and live smoke must be repeated.
